product_description: Low-voltage industrial control panel: wall-mounted enclosure with main isolator, miniature circuit breakers, 24 VDC power supply, PLC, contactors, relays and terminal blocks. Simplified representative model for a visual and documentation inspection demo. It is not a certified electrical design and does not claim conformity with any standard.
provenance: Prepared by the hackathon team to demonstrate a second industry. Fictional panel builder; all ratings are demonstration values, not taken from real datasheets.
